summary.text: Paul Sand is the Libertarian Party nominee for governor of Idaho, his second run for the office after the party's 2022 nomination. He lists his occupation as software engineer, computer-business entrepreneur and home builder, and says he served 10 years on the White Bird City Council.

paragraphs.text: Sand lives in White Bird, Idaho.
According to his campaign website, he is a retired computer software engineer who grew up in Minnesota and moved west about 30 years ago.
He says he served ten years on the White Bird City Council and was a member of the White Bird Volunteer Fire Department.
Sand was the Libertarian nominee for governor in 2022, and he says he won the party's primary for the 2026 race on May 19, 2026.
